questions.question:
Find the number of rectangles in the given figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d04487a9ebd9442b6f0fb1109f2a676d76d4ec8981fed12eb4baf2507e52f2d.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png] 

**__Rectangle__:** A rectangle is a*** four-sided figure*** or shape and ***all angles should be right angle.***

**__Square__:** A square, there are** *4 sides*** and ***all the four angles are right angles.***

**__Right Angle__*: ***A right angle is ***an angle of exactly 90°***, The angle bounded by*** two lines perpendicular*** to each other.

***A square is a special type of rectangle because it possesses all the properties of a rectangle. Similar to a rectangle, a square has:***

__
 
• Opposite sides that are parallel and equal.
 
• Two diagonals that bisect each other and are equal.

Thus, a*** square*** is a ***rectangle***.

The given figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79b546f1233cbdc17791cc6081208a176aca1578fa06173351272e9082bffcab.png] 

The rectangles in the figure: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, (1, 2)

Hence, **there are 6 rectangles in the figure.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

Squares are a subset of rectangles, hence, all squares are also rectangles.** **

questions.question:
Find the number of squares in the following figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebe1448e233ab6f784e8e62dd552778628649438fbaa2907175f6fcdecbc14df.png]
questions.solution:
Given figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c8889b5b6cf73be7a8fdc90d6eea1235b3f043a306aac4e6829d5de3cae4dd3.png] 

If the rows and columns in the given square are equal.

We take the sum of the squares of the number of rows or columns.

(1)² + (2)² + (3)² + (4)²

1 + 4 + 9 + 16

= 30

Hence, **30 **is correct.
